name: app-shater-admin-panel-customer-and-craftsman-tables-grid
title: Shater admin panel: six framed desktop screens of customer, craftsman and verification data tables
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of rounded desktop screenshots in the admin RTL panel: a customer list table, a customer detail profile with stats, a craftsman list with ratings and status dots, a verification request review with uploaded documents, and two more list/detail pairs, each in a thin pink-outlined frame.
whatItMeans: Operationally serious; dense RTL tables show the back-office tools needed to actually run a marketplace.
techniques: Frame each admin screen with a thin coloured outline.
Pair a list view with its matching detail view.
Use status dots for quick state scanning in tables.

vocabulary.definition: Rows and columns showing structured records.
A small coloured circle indicating a state.
